releases.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: short README, RFC 0001 and ADRs; remove orchestrate-era plans by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/93
* test: cover RFC 0001 on the real host; squad_metrics reports provider quota by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/94
* chore: release 0.6.1 by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/95


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): override vulnerable dev-only transitive packages by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/43
* fix(quota): report a provider rejection at any utilization by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/46
* fix(ttl): never pair a compaction with the turn after it by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/47
* fix(squad): refuse to apply over a damaged generated agent file by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/48
* fix(metrics): never show a base model's price on its tier by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/49
* test(integration): resume a child by session id in the real host and guard its hang by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/50
* quota: announce one continuous rejection once (#55) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/60
* cache-ttl: a turn without usage is no evidence of a miss (#57) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/61
* release: gate on integration tests and retry a missing npm publish (#58, #59) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/62
* Age llmbenchmark scores per metric by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/63
* fix: agent ownership from the header marker; refuse dangling symlinks (#51, #52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/64
* metrics: exact provider rows win; tier ctx and -free billing agree (#53, #54) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/65
* squad files: own only our markers; refuse paths that share one file (#51, #52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/66
* release: one version, one revision across tests, GitHub and npm (#58) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/67
* metrics: exact raw ids stay apart, old caches withhold serving facts, full view knows billing (#53, #54) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/68
* squad files: startup description sync honours shared destinations (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/69
* release: unknown remote state stops the run (#58) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/70
* metrics: one llmbenchmark identity per model across slices and views (#54) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/71
* squad files: shared destinations include agents in subdirectories (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/72
* metrics: earlier-format cache data gives no model its numbers (#54) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/73
* test(integration): one offline-network allowlist for every file (#74) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/77
* squad files: an unlistable subdirectory is uncertainty, not uniqueness (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/78
* test: drop disposable assertions and duplicate coverage (#75, #76) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/79
* squad files: walk agent/ and agents/ through directory links (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/80
* test(bootstrap): pin contracts, not prose (#76) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/81
* test(integration): no host is exempt from the offline fetch check (#74) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/82
* squad files: include mode/ agent sources, pinned to the OpenCode loader (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/83
* squad files: prune and migration go through the shared-destination check (#52) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/84
* Register squad agents through the plugin API instead of agent files (#85) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/86


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GFN-

## What's Changed
* squad_session tool; bootstrap in the system prompt (fixes cross-turn cache re-writes) — 0.5.0 by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/15


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/compare/v0.4.1...v0.5.0

## What's Changed
* 0.4.1: plugin-owned agent descriptions, provider routing rules by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/14


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

## What's Changed
* feat: live model metrics via squad_metrics; drop Artificial Analysis (0.4.0) by @AlexMKX in https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/pull/13


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GFN-CIS/opencode-squad/compare/v0.3.3...v0.4.0

issues.title: Roster mutations can address the same file through different agent paths
Keep code-health reports and analysis artifacts out of the public repository
Register squad agents through the plugin API instead of writing agent files
Recheck output token limits on OpenCode 2.1.3
Agent registration changes the effective configuration of a hand-authored agent sharing its ID
Disposable assertions fail on harmless edits and miss the behavior they claim to protect
